title: fix(app-shell): CodeWidget reads and writes an expression slot through the ADR-0089 envelope (objectui#10963)
body:
Fixes #10963
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`CodeWidget` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`) now picks its read/write path from the language the row declares:

- **`language: 'expression'`**: the editor text is `expressionSource(value)`, and each edit is written through `writeExpressionSource(value, next)`. This is the same pair and the same write rule `ConditionWidget` uses since objectui#3218. An envelope keeps `dialect` and `meta`, `source` is replaced, and the stale `ast` is dropped. A bare-string or undefined prior gets the bare shorthand back. A cleared editor writes `undefined`.
- **Every other language** (`javascript`, `html`, `jsx`, `json`, …) keeps today's string path, byte for byte. The value's shape is never sniffed, per the seat ruling (option A) on this card.

Before, the widget read `String(value)`. A stored ADR-0089 envelope showed as the literal text `[object Object]`, and the first edit wrote a bare string over it and dropped `meta`.

Behaviour change, stated in the changeset: **a cleared expression now writes `undefined` where `CodeWidget` wrote `''`**, the same as `ConditionWidget`.

Files: `widgets.tsx` (+28/−3), `CodeWidget.expressionEnvelope-10963.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases), `.changeset/10963-codewidget-expression-envelope.md` (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`).

## Measured language per row

`inferCodeLanguage(fieldSpec, schema)` for every `type: 'code'` row in the objectstack forms: objectstack `origin/main` `c745e2b896`, 17 `*.form.ts` files. Rendered through `CodeWidget` with the editor mocked to report its `language` prop.

| Form row | Declared / inferred language | Path after this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `object.form` `fields.visibleWhen` | `expression` | envelope |
| `object.form` `fields.readonlyWhen` | `expression` | envelope |
| `object.form` `fields.requiredWhen` | `expression` | envelope |
| `object.form` `fields.expression` (formula) | `expression` | envelope |
| `field.form` `visibleWhen` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428) | `expression` | envelope |
| `field.form` `readonlyWhen` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428) | `expression` | envelope |
| `field.form` `requiredWhen` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428) | `expression` | envelope |
| `hook.form` `condition` | `javascript` (a mislabel; see Acceptance notes) | string |
| `hook.form` `body.source` (script) | `javascript` | string |
| `action.form` `source` (script) | `javascript` | string |
| `email-template.form` `bodyHtml` (template) | `html` | string |
| `page.form` `source` | `jsx` | string |

Routing check: on the served output-mode schema, a predicate member is the husk `anyOf: [ {}, envelope ]`. `detectConditionWidget` declines it, and the row mounts `CodeWidget`. Measured with the verbatim `hookForm` `condition` row: it mounted `CodeWidget`, the editor showed `[object Object]`, and the condition builder did not mount.

## Pins: red on base, green on head

File: `CodeWidget.expressionEnvelope-10963.test.tsx`. `@object-ui/plugin-editor`'s `CodeEditorRenderer` is mocked as a controlled sink, a textarea that shows the `value` it is handed and reports each change through its `onChange`. Rows are looked up by name in the installed spec's `objectForm` / `hookForm`. Stored values are authored input parsed by `FieldSchema`.

| Case | Base `7a9db91481` | Head `bf1001ca8e` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| fixture premises (rows and spec-parsed envelope) | pass | pass |
| an envelope on an expression row renders its `source` | **FAIL**: expected `'[object Object]'` to be `record.type == 'invoice'` | pass |
| an edit round-trips to an envelope keeping `dialect` and `meta`, dropping `ast` | **FAIL**: received the bare string | pass |
| a cleared expression writes `undefined` | **FAIL**: expected `''` to be undefined | pass |
| control: bare-string prior reads as itself and writes the bare shorthand | pass | pass |
| control: undefined prior starts empty and writes the bare shorthand | pass | pass |
| non-expression control: a `javascript` row (hook `body.source` shape) holding an envelope-looking object stays on the string path | pass | pass |

- Base leg: BASE's `widgets.tsx` blob `c1b5b785cf4e` was put under the committed pins and restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. The restore was proven by the blob matching HEAD's (`4cce2e379a68`) and by an empty `git diff HEAD`. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)`, `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
- Head: `Tests 7 passed (7)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

**Ablations** at `bf1001ca8e`, each through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was confirmed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed) and restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| Mutation | Red | Green |
|:--|:--|:--|
| READ: the expression arm reads `String(value)` again | the `source`-render pin only | 6 |
| WRITE: `onChange(next ?? '')` for every language | the round-trip pin and the cleared-expression pin | 5 |
| control lit, value-shape sniff (option B) | the non-expression control only | 6 |
| control lit, always-envelope write | round-trip plus both bare-string/undefined controls | 4 |

## Gates (at `bf1001ca8e` unless noted)

Run after building the dependency closure with `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console`, 35 tasks. The test project reads the pin file: it refused a missing `schema` prop in it before commit `bf1001ca8e`.
- Tests of every file that imports `widgets.tsx` or `expression-envelope.ts`: 91 files, enumerated with `git grep`. That is 23 direct test importers, the tests of the 8 source importers (`SchemaForm`, `ResourceEditPage`, `ActionDefaultInspector`, `FlowEdgeInspector`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `PageBlockInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `ObjectValidationsPanel`), and the tests that read `widgets.tsx` from disk. Results: `47 passed (47)` with `Tests 396 passed`, then `44 passed (44)` with `Tests 491 passed`. Both ran at `47daa79e27`, whose `widgets.tsx` blob equals head's. The pin file re-ran at head.
- `check-changeset-presence`: ✅ 1 released package, 1 changeset.
- `check-changeset-no-major`: ✅.
- `check:pending-changeset-literals`: ✅.
- `check:changeset-claims`: report-only. 3 pending changesets name `widgets.tsx` (`7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired`, `8218-studio-property-panel-de-developerize`, `formfieldspec-dependson-5040`). Re-read: none describes `CodeWidget`, and all stay true.

- `check:control-bytes`: ✅.
- **Console eager closure.** `widgets.tsx` is in it: `CodeWidget`'s code lands in the `SchemaForm` chunk, which the eager report lists. Both states were measured on console builds. Base `3177817` B (3103.3 KB), head `3177847` B (3103.4 KB): **+30 B gzipped**. The `SchemaForm` chunk moved from 31752 to 31786 B. Gate on head: ✅ `3103.4 KB … (budget: 3104.5 KB, headroom: 1.1 KB)`.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree`: clean against `origin/main` `deca847a8a`, and clean against PR objectui#10962's head `c292a64004`. The two PRs share no file.
- Targeted `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two changed source files: 0 errors, and no warning on a changed line. This is not a proven narrowing, because the repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hook `condition` row is carried by objectstack-ai/objectstack#20439.** `hook.form.ts` declares it `language: 'javascript'` over `HookSchema.condition`, which is a CEL predicate stored as the envelope. By this PR's rule it stays on the string path. The live Studio reads the form served by `/meta/types` from the running server, so the row routes to the envelope path as soon as the producer declares `expression`, with no objectui change. The bundled offline fallback (`@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 installed here) follows at the next spec bump.
- A cleared expression writes `undefined` (the key is removed) instead of `''`. This matches `ConditionWidget` and is stated in the changeset.
- No doc sentence becomes false: `git grep -i 'CodeWidget|code widget'` over `*.md` / `*.mdx` finds nothing outside this PR's changeset.
